description: SoC ramp and power curve for a single selected charging session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT energy_kwh AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id

SELECT COALESCE(cost, est_cost) AS value FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ended_at, now())-started_at))/60.0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id
SELECT avg_power_kw AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id
SELECT max_power_kw AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id
SELECT (end_soc-start_soc) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id

SELECT ts AS time, battery_level AS "SoC (%)" FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=(SELECT id FROM vehicles LIMIT 1) AND ts BETWEEN (SELECT started_at FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id) AND (SELECT COALESCE(ended_at, now()) FROM charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id) ORDER BY ts

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, power_kw AS "Power (kW)" FROM charging_curve_points WHERE session_id=$charge_id AND source=COALESCE((SELECT source FROM charging_curve_points WHERE session_id=$charge_id ORDER BY (source='graph') DESC, (source='observed') DESC LIMIT 1),'graph') ORDER BY ts

SELECT started_at AS "Started", ended_at AS "Ended", COALESCE(loc_name, CASE WHEN is_home_s THEN 'Home' WHEN is_public THEN 'Public' ELSE 'Other' END) AS "Location", rate_s AS "Rate / kWh", lat AS "Lat", lon AS "Lon", charger_type AS "Charger Type", is_rivian_charger AS "Rivian Charger", wallbox_id AS "Wallbox", currency AS "Currency" FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE id=$charge_id
